title: Integrity protection of NAS signalling messages

entities.name: NAS signalling message
entities.description: A Non-Access Stratum message used for control signalling between UE and network.

entities.name: Integrity protection
entities.description: Security feature that ensures NAS signalling messages are protected against modification.

entities.name: Security context
entities.description: The established security parameters between UE and network required for integrity protection.

relations.description: NAS signalling messages require integrity protection when security context is established.
Integrity protection is conditional upon the existence of a valid security context.
